Callout.Name: Drone Over the Perimeter
Callout.Message: Drone seen over a secure perimeter.
Callout.Advisory: Drone still airborne, operator believed nearby.

Script.Line: I am flying it over the field. The field is public.
You can look at the footage. There is nothing on the footage.
I can bring it down. Just tell me to bring it down.

Lines.Approach: Somebody is flying a drone over the fence and they are not doing it for the view.
Lines.SignOff: Show me 10-8 when you are clear.
